title: Opening a record page full-page: draw the app shell as soon as the session is confirmed, not after all metadata arrives
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Split from #35416 (item 3) by its card thread. Part of epic #34571.

## What a user sees
Opening a record page in a new tab shows 「正在打开你的控制台…」 until every boot read has arrived, even after the session is confirmed. On a hosted environment that screen stays up for seconds.

## Why
The console's readiness gate (objectui#5619 / #12809) holds the whole shell until the metadata it needs is in. #35416's PR moves the page's own reads earlier and takes `/api/v1/packages` off the boot path, but it leaves the gate as it is.

## To do
1. Read what the gate waits for and why (the two objectui issues and the code behind them).
2. Render the app shell (top bar, navigation frame, an empty content area with a skeleton) once the session is confirmed, and let the page fill in as its reads arrive. Keep any guarantee the gate exists for (for example, no flash of a wrong app or of unauthorised navigation).
3. Measure before/after on the same page, as #35416 does.

## Acceptance
- With JS cached, the shell appears right after the session read, before the page's metadata reads finish.
- No wrong-app or unauthorised-menu flash in the meantime.

Blocked-by: #35416's PR.
Reader: area:ux (ui/apps/console, ui/packages/app-shell).
